updates.title: New Domain!!
updates.body:
i know it's funny that this is my first rss entry despite being my site, but for such a special moment i want to document this
the site now has it's own domain!! zescrew2.art to be specific ^u^
i just want to say, thank you. ty, sap, lynn, pebbz, everyone. thank you for letting me get to this point <:D
i would not be who i am without all of you, so thank you
- Lily (ZesCrew2)

updates.title: Optimizations.
updates.body:
As much as I've been wanting to take a break for a while, working on the site is what I've done for these past few days (just to clarify this isn't Lily speaking, it's thorns) and I am having a lot of fun doing this. I've discovered a workflow that allows me to also have time for both myself and to spend time with my family. 

I decided to pull out my magnum opus of an update, an overall optimization of the site, to at least try and get it to run on low end devices, sooooo... Hopefully it works. I mean it loads up pretty fast (to be fair my pc is pretty beefy so I can understand why...)

Love you all. Stay safe!

updates.title: Update!
updates.body: Hello everyone! Thanks for checking the RSS page. I've added a few gizmos and trinkets for you to discover, so if anything looks out of the ordinary, take a closer look. Love you guys.

updates.title: Brand New Page!
updates.body: Hello everyone! Thorns here. It's nice that I was able to get this to work. Now everytime an update happens, changelogs will appear **here**. Hope everything goes well and we get to to see what happens in the future!!!

updates.body: I am testing to see if this fucking thing works, I'll delete it later. *Test*. **Test**.
